metas.title: HTML meta title for the privacy policy page. Shown in browser tab and search engine results.
metas.description: HTML meta description for the privacy policy page. Shown in search engine results. Should summarize the key points: cookies, no tracking, no personal data.

elements.breadcrumb: Breadcrumb label for the privacy policy page. Shown in the navigation path. Single word.

body.md_1: Full body text of the privacy policy page. Markdown-formatted with H1 heading and H2 sub-sections. Three sections: Cookies & Tracking, Data Storage, and Infrastructure. Uses bold text for emphasis — preserve all markdown formatting. Keep language simple and accessible for non-legal readers.
